domain_mismatch_note: RSVQA-LR images are aerial RGB photography at roughly 0.1m ground sample distance. The evaluated LoRA adapter (mlp1.1/mlp1.3) was trained on Sentinel-2 EuroSAT imagery at 10m ground sample distance -- a different sensor and roughly 100x coarser resolution. This accuracy score reflects that domain gap, not a broken evaluation pipeline.
scope_note: This result covers AC2 (RSVQA-LR) only. AC1 (BigEarthNet.txt manually-verified benchmark split) is out of scope for YASH-007 and owned by ROHAN-008.
